userContent.text:
Build an interactive 2D figure from the brief below and the source image.

AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure stacks two ray-tracing constructions, panel (a) for a concave mirror and panel (b) for a convex mirror, each drawn in cross section with the mirror as a pale curved arc on the right. In (a) a red upward arrow at the far left is labeled Object, its base P resting on the horizontal optical axis and its tip Q above; the axis also carries the points C, P prime, F, and the vertex V. Four color-coded rays numbered 1 through 4 leave Q: ray 1 in blue runs parallel to the axis and reflects back through F, ray 2 in red arrives along a line through F and leaves parallel to the axis, ray 3 in purple heads toward C and returns along itself with a small right-angle square at the mirror, and ray 4 in green strikes V and reflects symmetrically across the axis. All four cross at Q prime, the tip of a short red downward arrow labeled Image whose base P prime lies between C and F, and a small drawn eye at the lower left looks toward the mirror. Panel (b) repeats the construction on a convex mirror whose focal point F and center of curvature C lie behind the arc: the reflected rays spread apart, and their dashed backward extensions meet at Q prime, tip of a smaller upright red arrow labeled Image standing behind the mirror between V and F. Pairing the panels contrasts rays that genuinely converge with an image sitting only where extensions cross.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Toggle between concave mirror and convex mirror: learner switches the named mirror type; the reflected rays either meet in front of the mirror or spread while dashed backward extensions meet behind it; the difference between real and virtual image formation becomes clear.
- Click on principal ray 1, 2, 3, or 4: learner selects one numbered ray; that ray brightens from object tip to mirror and along its reflected or extended path; the specific ray rule behind each construction is isolated from the busy crossing diagram.
- Slider for object distance from the mirror: learner moves the object along the optical axis; the image arrow shifts, flips, and changes size for the concave case while the convex image stays upright and virtual; the relationship among object position, focal point, and image character becomes clear.

SOURCE FILE: OpenStax University Physics, chapter 35: Geometric Optics and Image Formation

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

Vx - R : Vx + R; } function Fx(t){ return t === 'concave' ? Vx - F : Vx + F; } function mirrorX(yup, t){ var s = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, R * R - yup * yup)); return t === 'concave' ? Vx - R + s : Vx + R - s; } function norm(v){ var l = Math.hypot(v.x, v.y) || 1; return { x: v.x / l, y: v.y / l }; } function sub(a, b){ return { x: a.x - b.x, y: a.y - b.y }; } function hitCircle(Q, u, cx){ var dx = Q.x - cx, dy = Q.y - axisY; var b = dx * u.x + dy * u.y, c = dx * dx + dy * dy - R * R; var disc = b * b - c; if (disc < 0) return null; var t = -b - Math.sqrt(disc); if (t < 1) t = -b + Math.sqrt(disc); return { x: Q.x + u.x * t, y: Q.y + u.y * t }; } function pts(a){ return a.map(function(p){ return p[0] + ',' + p[1]; }).join(' '); } function txt(g, s, x, y, o){ o = o || {}; return g.text(s).move(x, y).attr({ 'font-size': o.size || 15, 'font-style': o.italic ? 'italic' : 'normal', 'font-weight': o.bold ? 'bold' : 'normal', fill: o.color || '#333', 'text-anchor': o.anchor || 'middle', 'paint-order': 'stroke', stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 3, 'stroke-linejoin': 'round' }); } function arrowHead(g, x, y, a, s, col){ g.polygon(pts([[x, y], [x - s * Math.cos(a - 0.42), y - s * Math.sin(a - 0.42)], [x - s * Math.cos(a + 0.42), y - s * Math.sin(a + 0.42)]])).fill(col); } function drawAll(){ root.clear(); var t = state.type, cx = Cx(t), fx = Fx(t); var ox = Vx - state.do; var Q = { x: ox, y: axisY - hObj }, P = { x: ox, y: axisY }; // optical axis root.line(15, axisY, 745, axisY).stroke({ color: '#555', width: 1.4 }); // mirror arc (pale, thick) + back-side ticks var arc = [], i; for (i = -AP; i <= AP; i += 5) arc.push([mirrorX(i, t), axisY - i]); root.polyline(pts(arc)).fill('none').stroke({ color: '#aec6d2', width: 11, opacity: 0.75, linecap: 'round' }); root.polyline(pts(arc)).fill('none').stroke({ color: '#7d99a8', width: 1.2, opacity: 0.8 }); var back = (t === 'concave') ? 8 : -8; for (i = -140; i <= 140; i += 47) { var mx = mirrorX(i, t); root.line(mx + back * 0.4, axisY - i, mx + back * 2.2, axisY - i - 9) .stroke({ color: '#7d99a8', width: 1.2, opacity: 0.7 }); } // image location from the mirror equation: 1/f = 1/do + 1/di var f = (t === 'concave') ? F : -F; var den = (state.do - f) / (f * state.do); var di = 1 / den; if (!isFinite(di)) di = 1500; di = Math.max(-1500, Math.min(1500, di)); var m = -di / state.do, hi = m * hObj; var real = di > 0; var Qp = { x: Vx - di, y: axisY - hi }, Pp = { x: Vx - di, y: axisY }; // object arrow (red, up) var og = root.group(); og.line(ox, axisY, ox, axisY - hObj).stroke({ color: '#d62728', width: 3 }); arrowHead(og, ox, axisY - hObj - 9, -Math.PI / 2, 13, '#d62728'); og.circle(6).center(ox, axisY).fill('#1f5fbf'); txt(root, 'Q', ox, axisY - hObj - 28, { italic: true, bold: true }); txt(root, 'P', ox, axisY + 22, { italic: true, bold: true }); txt(root, 'Object', ox - 30, axisY - 55, { size: 16 }).transform({ rotate: -90, cx: ox - 30, cy: axisY - 55 }); // image arrow (red) var ig = root.group(); if (Math.abs(hi) > 4) { ig.line(Pp.x, axisY, Qp.x, Qp.y).stroke({ color: '#d62728', width: 3 }); arrowHead(ig, Qp.x, Qp.y + (hi > 0 ? -9 : 9), hi > 0 ? -Math.PI / 2 : Math.PI / 2, 11, '#d62728'); } txt(root, "P'", Pp.x + 2, axisY + 22, { italic: true, bold: true }); txt(root, "Q'", Qp.x + 18, Qp.y - 4, { italic: true, bold: true }); txt(root, 'Image', Pp.x + 40, axisY + 44, { size: 15 }); // axis points C, F, V root.circle(7).center(cx, axisY).fill('#222'); txt(root, 'C', cx, axisY + 20, { italic: true, bold: true }); root.circle(7).center(fx, axisY).fill('#d62728'); txt(root, 'F', fx, axisY + 20, { italic: true, bold: true }); txt(root, 'V', Vx + (t === 'concave' ? 14 : -16), axisY + 4, { italic: true, bold: true }); // four principal rays from Q var C = { x: cx, y: axisY }, Fp = { x: fx, y: axisY }, V = { x: Vx, y: axisY }; for (var k = 1; k <= 4; k++) { var col = RAYCOL[k], M, d, u; if (k === 1) M = { x: mirrorX(hObj, t), y: Q.y }; else if (k === 2) { u = norm(sub(Fp, Q)); M = hitCircle(Q, u, cx); } else if (k === 3) { u = norm(sub(C, Q)); M = hitCircle(Q, u, cx); } else M = { x: Vx, y: axisY }; if (!M) continue; d = norm(sub(M, Q)); var n = norm(sub(M, C)); // outward (radial) normal var dn = d.x * n.x + d.y * n.y; var r = norm({ x: d.x - 2 * dn * n.x, y: d.y - 2 * dn * n.y }); // true reflection var g = root.group().css('cursor', 'pointer'); var dim = (state.ray !== 0 && state.ray !== k); g.opacity(dim ? 0.15 : 1); // incident ray Q -> M g.line(Q.x, Q.y, M.x, M.y).stroke({ color: col, width: dim ? 1.6 : 2.4 }); var mi = { x: (Q.x + M.x) / 2, y: (Q.y + M.y) / 2 }; arrowHead(g, mi.x, mi.y, Math.atan2(d.y, d.x), 10, col); if (real) { // rays genuinely converge: solid through Q' and beyond g.line(M.x, M.y, Qp.x, Qp.y).stroke({ color: col, width: dim ? 1.6 : 2.4 }); g.line(Qp.x, Qp.y, Qp.x + r.x * 110, Qp.y + r.y * 110) .stroke({ color: col, width: dim ? 1.6 : 2.4 }); var mr = { x: (M.x + Qp.x) / 2, y: (M.y + Qp.y) / 2 }; arrowHead(g, mr.x, mr.y, Math.atan2(r.y, r.x), 10, col); } else { // virtual: reflected ray diverges; dashed backward extension meets at Q' g.line(M.x, M.y, M.x + r.x * 430, M.y + r.y * 430) .stroke({ color: col, width: dim ? 1.6 : 2.4 }); arrowHead(g, M.x + r.x * 200, M.y + r.y * 200, Math.atan2(r.y, r.x), 10, col); g.line(M.x, M.y, Qp.x - r.x * 0 + (Qp.x - M.x) * 1.0 + 0, Qp.y) .stroke({ color: col, width: 1.6, opacity: 0.85 }).attr('stroke-dasharray', '6,4'); g.line(Qp.x, Qp.y, Qp.x - r.x * 45, Qp.y - r.y * 45) .stroke({ color: col, width: 1.6, opacity: 0.85 }).attr('stroke-dasharray', '6,4'); } // ray number label near the incident segment var off = { x: -d.y, y: d.x }; txt(g, String(k), mi.x + off.x * 14 - 4, mi.y + off.y * 14 - 16, { color: col, bold: true, size: 16 }); // right-angle square for ray 3 (normal incidence) if (k === 3) { var back2 = norm(sub(Q, M)); var tg = { x: -n.y, y: n.x }; if (tg.y * (axisY - M.y) < 0) tg = { x: -tg.x, y: -tg.y }; var s = 13; var A = { x: M.x + back2.x * s, y: M.y + back2.y * s }; var B = { x: A.x + tg.x * s, y: A.y + tg.y * s }; var Cc = { x: M.x + tg.x * s, y: M.y + tg.y * s }; g.polyline(pts([[A.x, A.y], [B.x, B.y], [Cc.x, Cc.y]])).fill('none') .stroke({ color: '#555', width: 1.3 }); } (function(g2, kk){ g2.on('mousemove', function(e){ showTooltip(RULES[kk], e); }) .on('mouseleave', hideTooltip) .on('click', function(){ select_ray(state.ray === kk ? 0 : kk); }); })(g, k); } // simple eye looking toward the mirror var ex = 110, ey = 445, eg = root.group(); eg.path('M' + ex + ',' + ey + ' Q' + (ex + 30) + ',' + (ey - 28) + ' ' + (ex + 60) + ',' + ey + ' Q' + (ex + 30) + ',' + (ey + 18) + ' ' + ex + ',' + ey + ' Z') .fill('none').stroke({ color: '#444', width: 2 }); eg.circle(13).center(ex + 38, ey - 3).fill('none').stroke({ color: '#444', width: 2 }); eg.line(ex + 18, ey - 18, ex + 12, ey - 28).stroke({ color: '#444', width: 2 }); eg.line(ex + 32, ey - 23, ex + 30, ey - 34).stroke({ color: '#444', width: 2 }); eg.line(ex + 46, ey - 20, ex + 50, ey - 31).stroke({ color: '#444', width: 2 }); eg.line(ex + 52, ey + 14, ex + 60, ey + 24).stroke({ color: '#444', width: 2 }); eg.on('mousemove', function(e){ showTooltip('The eye sees the image where the (extended) rays crossing it appear to come from.', e); }) .on('mouseleave', hideTooltip).css('cursor', 'pointer'); // panel label txt(root, t === 'concave' ? '(a)' : '(b)', W / 2, 520, { size: 16 }); // status readout var st = document.getElementById('imgStatus'); if (st) { var mag = Math.abs(m); var sizeWord = mag > 1.05 ? 'magnified' : (mag < 0.95 ? 'reduced' : 'same size'); st.textContent = 'Image: ' + (real ? 'REAL (rays converge in front)' : 'VIRTUAL (only dashed extensions meet)') + ', ' + (m < 0 ? 'inverted' : 'upright') + ', ' + sizeWord + ' · f = ' + (F) + ', d\u1D62 = ' + Math.round(state.do) + ', d\u1D62\u2032 = ' + Math.round(di); } window.__markRendered(); } function update_dist(v){ state.do = v; drawAll(); } function toggle_type(on){ state.type = on ? 'convex' : 'concave'; drawAll(); } function select_ray(n){ state.ray = n; for (var i = 0; i <= 4; i++) { var b = document.getElementById('rayBtn' + i); if (b) b.className = 'raybtn' + (i === n ? ' active' : ''); } drawAll(); } select_ray(0); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
